blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated sightseeing and sunset cruises on local waterways, private water taxi services to nearby islands, custom boat excursions including island hopping and paddleboarding, and catered seafood boil dining experiences on the water. The cruises offer wildlife viewing including dolphins and birds, and the boats have shaded seating and restrooms on some vessels. Private charters are available for groups with options for island stops and water activities.
